title: EARLIER with no outer row context is an error
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( Product, Product[Price] > EARLIER ( Product[Price] ) )

expected.error: there is only one row context on Product (the one FILTER opens), so EARLIER has no earlier row context to read

source.quote: EARLIER succeeds if there is a row context prior to the beginning of the table scan. Otherwise it returns an error.
source.supports: EARLIER needs an outer row context

derivation: The query has a single scan of Product, by FILTER. There is no row context before that scan, so EARLIER fails.
